name: Introduction and overview — P-3 Orion — aircraft record
title: Introduction and overview — P-3 Orion
description: Introduction and overview of the P-3 Orion: What this aircraft is, its role, and why it matters in aviation history. The P-3 Orion is a four-engine maritime patrol aircraft built by Lockheed, entering service in 1962. For six decades it hunted submarines with magnetic-anomaly detectors, sonobuoys, and torpedoes. 757 were built; the type served the U.S. Navy and many allies before P-8 Poseidon replacement. Baseline facts: Maritime patrol/anti-submarine aircraft; service from 1962; 757 built by Lockheed..
how_it_works: Wings generate lift from airflow; the engine provides thrust; control surfaces and fly-by-wire or mechanical controls steer the aircraft in three axes.
